description: Zerodha is India's largest stock brokerage platform, offering discount trading services for stocks, derivatives, mutual funds, and more. It is known for its transparent pricing and technology-driven trading ecosystem.

products.Daily Savings: Not applicable for Zerodha; users can instead invest small amounts via mutual funds and SIPs
products.Digital Gold: Zerodha users can buy and sell digital gold via its partner platform, GoldRush by Kshitij
products.Jar App: Zerodha's primary platform is the Kite app, offering advanced charting and trading tools
products.Auto-Save: Users can automate investments through SIPs in mutual funds using Coin, Zerodha’s investment platform

pricing.Account Opening: Equity account opening is free during offers; otherwise nominal charges apply
pricing.Savings: Investing in mutual funds via Coin is completely free
pricing.Digital Gold Purchase: Digital gold purchase involves standard partner charges; Zerodha does not levy additional fees
pricing.Gold Storage: Secure storage handled by the gold partner with standard vaulting fees included
pricing.Withdrawal: No withdrawal fee for selling gold; brokerage charges apply on market trades

faq.question: What is Zerodha?
faq.answer: Zerodha is India's leading discount broker, offering low-cost trading and investment services across equity, F&O, commodities, currency, and mutual funds.

faq.question: How does Zerodha work?
faq.answer: Users open a trading and Demat account, add funds, and can buy or sell stocks and other instruments through the Kite web or mobile platform.

faq.question: Is there any minimum amount to start?
faq.answer: There is no minimum amount required to open an account or start trading. Users can begin buying stocks with any amount allowed by the market.

faq.question: How much does Zerodha cost?
faq.answer: Equity delivery trades are free, while intraday and F&O trades cost ₹20 per order or 0.03%, whichever is lower.

faq.question: Is my money safe with Zerodha?
faq.answer: Yes, Zerodha is a SEBI-registered broker, and all client securities are held safely in NSDL/CDSL depositories. Funds remain in segregated client accounts.

faq.question: Can I withdraw my money anytime?
faq.answer: Yes, withdrawals can be initiated through the Zerodha console. Funds are transferred to the registered bank account within standard settlement timelines.

faq.question: What is digital gold?
faq.answer: Digital gold represents 24K gold stored securely in vaults. Zerodha enables buying/selling digital gold through its partner GoldRush.

faq.question: Do you have a mobile app?
faq.answer: Yes, Zerodha offers the Kite trading app and the Coin mutual fund investment app on both Android and iOS.
